Up to €28 million is planned for the development work.

estonia.title: Agricultural Museum renamed MUHK, opens new permanent exhibition
estonia.description: Starting Friday, the Estonian Agricultural Museum in Ülenurme, Tartu County, will operate under a new name: Maaelu uudishimukeskus (Rural Curiosity Center), or MUHK. The new name reflects the museum's expanding scope.

estonia.title: Tartu Illustration Festival back for third year with European guests
estonia.description: Tartu Illustration Festival (TIF) is back September 25–26, bringing together creators from Estonia and beyond for two days of workshops, talks, a market and more.

estonia.title: Estonia and the U.S. seek rare‑earth agreement
estonia.description: Estonia and the United States are working toward an agreement on rare earth elements to strengthen supply security. The talks are not about Estonia's mineral deposits; the goal is to develop local industry and attract new investment, says Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna. On Thursday, Lithuania signed a similar agreement with the U.S.

estonia.title: AI professor: Today's chatbots will not end civilization
estonia.description: In recent weeks, leading figures in the tech world have grown increasingly vocal in warning about the risks posed by the rapid development of artificial intelligence. However, University of Tartu Professor of Artificial Intelligence Meelis Kull says there is currently no existential risk.

estonia.title: Rail Baltica deadline shift could help Estonia tap more EU funds
estonia.description: Construction on the Tallinn–Pärnu section will continue, but work on other segments can be postponed, says infrastructure minister Kuldar Leis.

estonia.title: Day of Countryside Living organizer says rural life best suits active people
estonia.description: Reve Lambur, the lead organizer of Day of Countryside Living, said that anyone interested in rural life should definitely go meet the vibrant communities who are eager to welcome new residents.

estonia.title: Parties step up work on candidate lists ahead of March Riigikogu elections
estonia.description: With less than half a year until the Riigikogu elections, Estonia's major political parties are assembling candidate lists and drafting election programs. Some have already begun campaigning, while others will finalize their lists and platforms only in January.

estonia.title: Justice chancellor challenges Estonia's new retirement age system
estonia.description: Justice Chancellor Ülle Madise is questioning a new retirement age system that could mean people in Estonia born in the same year start receiving a pension at different times.

estonia.title: Experts: Russia's elections have no impact on Estonia
estonia.description: The pseudo‑elections that began in Russia on Friday do not directly affect Estonia, according to foreign‑policy experts Rainer Saks, Karmo Tüür and Marko Mihkelson. What is interesting, they noted, is how many Russian citizens living in Estonia will go vote for the State Duma.

estonia.title: Transport Administration to install thermal cameras to count road users
estonia.description: The Transport Administration is installing thermal cameras along major highways to collect data on when, at what speed, and what types of vehicles are traveling there.

estonia.title: Gallery: Tallinn opens city's first drone training classroom for kids
estonia.description: Tallinn opened its first drone training classroom on Friday, giving kids and teens in the Estonian capital a chance to learn hands-on skills in a fast-growing field.

estonia.title: Search expert: Wise to have a relative know your secret mushroom spot
estonia.description: People heading into the woods should wear white clothing or a neon-colored reflective vest, determine their location before entering the woods and tell a family member or trusted friend where their secret mushroom-picking spot is, a PPA expert told ERR.

estonia.title: Estonia enters ETS reform talks without setting numerical targets
estonia.description: The Riigikogu's EU Affairs Committee (ELAK) clarified the government's mandate for negotiations on reforming the Emissions Trading System (ETS) at its meeting on Friday, but avoided setting any numerical parameters.

estonia.title: Organizers seek way for signers to join expanded 2028 Song Celebration
estonia.description: This week marked the official start of preparations for the XIV Youth Song and Dance Celebration and the XXIX Song and XXII Dance Celebration, taking place in summer 2028. Artistic director of the Song Celebration, Riivo Jõgi, said that some changes can be expected, and meetings are underway to find a suitable solution for sign‑language performers.

estonia.title: Estonia seeks more stores to join emergency preparedness network
estonia.description: Estonia has 60 emergency-ready gas stations and 79 stores equipped with generators in case of a power outage. By the end of the year, the number of such stores is expected to reach 110.

estonia.title: Prosecutors drop case against man who arranged break‑in to retrieve his cat
estonia.description: The Northern District Prosecutor's Office has closed a criminal case against a man who arranged a break‑in at a stranger's apartment to retrieve his missing cat.

estonia.title: Olympic medalists Henry Sildaru, Eileen Gu join X Games' Golden State
estonia.description: Estonian freestyle skier and Olympic silver medalist Henry Sildaru was drafted to XC Golden State, where he'll team up with gold medalist Eileen Gu in the new X Games league.

estonia.title: Number of medical residents hits record high
estonia.description: This fall, 187 new medical residents began specialist training at the University of Tartu, bringing the total number of residents to a record 891. In recent years, interest and competition have intensified in critical specialties such as family medicine and emergency medicine, the university said.

estonia.title: EDF intel chief: Russian losses at over 10,000 soldiers for third consecutive week
estonia.description: Russian armed forces losses in the war of aggression against Ukraine have remained above 10,000 troops for the third consecutive week, exceeding the number of new soldiers being recruited, said Col. Ants Kiviselg, head of the EDF Intelligence Center.

estonia.title: Andres Tropp: Climate policy must account for technological reality
estonia.description: Europe needs an emissions trading system that works — one that pushes companies to adopt better technologies but does not force European industry to shut down before those technologies actually exist, writes Andres Tropp.

estonia.title: Harri Tiido: Geopolitics in an era when rules no longer work
estonia.description: In his commentary series, Harri Tiido this time examines survival in chaos with the help of Mark Leonard. Leonard writes that today's global divide is not so much between democracies and autocracies or East and West, but between different approaches to the very idea of order, Tiido notes.

estonia.title: Estonian sumo wrestler joins Japan's professional league
estonia.description: Estonian sumo wrestler Anatoli Zadorožnõi has officially joined Japan's professional sumo league, the Estonian Sumo Association announced.

estonia.title: Lihtsad uudised 18. septembril
estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Listen and read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Canadian cycling experts: The car still feels like king in Tallinn and Tartu
estonia.description: Although cycling and pedestrian infrastructure in Tallinn and Tartu has improved in recent years, there is no common standard, sustainable mobility experts Melissa and Chris Bruntlett noted

estonia.title: Tallinn to evaluate condition of trees from photos in new tree-felling rules
estonia.description: Tallinn is preparing changes to its tree-felling regulations aimed at simplifying permit requirements, reducing bureaucracy and expanding the use of digital tools while protecting the city's trees.

estonia.title: Overcrowded buses leaving Tartu suburb students behind
estonia.description: Students catching buses from Kõrveküla Basic School toward Tartu are increasingly being left behind by overcrowding, with no relief in sight before 2028.

estonia.title: Incoming economy minister on conflict of interest allegations: I have done nothing wrong
estonia.description: In an interview with ERR, newly appointed Minister of Economic Affairs and Industry Liina Vahtras discusses allegations of a conflict of interest, Estonia's economic outlook, rising costs, business support and her turbulent first days in office.

estonia.title: Margit Sutrop: AI Leap requires technological courage and educational wisdom
estonia.description: As Estonia brings artificial intelligence into its schools through AI Leap, its success will depend not on how widely the technology is used, but on whether it strengthens learning while safeguarding teachers' role, educational values and the Estonian language and culture.

estonia.title: Kode9, Hyperdub founder and dubstep pioneer, to play Tallinn
estonia.description: British electronic music legend Kode9, founder of the Hyperdub label and a pioneer of dubstep, will perform at Paavli Kultuurivabrik in Tallinn in November.

estonia.title: Finance ministry sees no way to lower diesel excise duty despite soaring prices
estonia.description: Diesel prices have risen 36 cents per liter in two weeks. Fuel retailers and hauliers are calling for a cut in excise duty, but the Ministry of Finance says the tight state budget rules this out.

estonia.title: Tallinn Zoo's binturongs attempted multiple escapes
estonia.description: Young binturongs at Tallinn Zoo staged several successful escape attempts from their enclosure, forcing the Tropical House to close to visitors. The pair, Maru and Maimu, have now been moved to a new location where slipping away won't be nearly as easy.

estonia.title: Court suspends hunting of bears given nuisance status
estonia.description: The Tallinn Circuit Court has suspended permits to hunt problem bears pending a ruling on an appeal filed by NGO Eesti Suurkiskjad, which had challenged the permits.

estonia.title: Estonia weighs pushing Rail Baltica completion to 2034
estonia.description: Estonia's government is considering pushing back its Rail Baltica completion target to 2034 to make greater use of EU funding and reduce the rail project's cost to taxpayers.

estonia.title: Estonia's state budget talks enter final stretch as deficit target looms
estonia.description: Estonia's government is aiming to wrap up 2027 state budget talks next week, with ministers weighing spending needs against a target to cut the budget deficit to 4 percent.

estonia.title: Estonian golfer and US college team win Kentucky tournament
estonia.description: A young Estonian contributed to his US college's victory in a golf tournament earlier this week.

estonia.title: Gallery: Tallinn's Kadriorg Park glows as 'Light Walks' festival is back
estonia.description: As the days grow shorter, Tallinn's annual "Light Walks" ("Valgus kõnnib") festival returns, transforming Kadriorg Park into an immersive canvas of light and music.

estonia.title: Estonia to assess security risks in nuclear plant site selection
estonia.description: Estonia is commissioning a security threat assessment for six sites in Viru-Nigula and Lüganuse municipalities being considered for the country's first nuclear power plant.

estonia.title: PM: Estonia ready to immediately close border in case of Russian mobilization
estonia.description: Estonia is preparing for possible security risks if Russia declares a general mobilization, with Prime Minister Kristen Michal saying the country could close its border immediately if the threat assessment warrants it.

estonia.title: Kaja Kallas: Russia using hybrid attacks to erode Europe's support for Ukraine
estonia.description: The European Union's High Representative for Foreign Affairs, Kaja Kallas, said that Russia's increasing hybrid attacks, acts of sabotage, and stray drones are aimed at frightening the residents of European countries and deterring them from supporting Ukraine.

estonia.title: Argo Ideon: Canada, our great new bestie
estonia.description: The constant nagging about how Canada should become the 51st U.S. state has worn out the northern nation, and now as many as 81 percent of Canadians favor closer ties with the European Union, writes Argo Ideon.

estonia.title: Aleksei Gaidajenko: Emergency rooms are for treatment, not sobriety checks
estonia.description: Plans to give emergency departments a greater role in determining intoxication would add to their already heavy workload and blur the line between medical care and evidence gathering, writes Aleksei Gaidajenko.

estonia.title: Minister's past roles prompt scrutiny of startup funding decisions
estonia.description: Liina Vahtras, who has just become minister of economic affairs and industry, previously served on the management board of the Estonian Business and Innovation Agency (EIS) and also sat on the board of Rochna Invest OÜ — a company whose portfolio startups received a total of €1.25 million in support from EIS during the same period. Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Vahtras acted in accordance with the rules because she did not take part in making the funding decisions.

estonia.title: Unemployment insurance premium rates frozen through 2030
estonia.description: Estonia will keep unemployment insurance premium rates unchanged through 2030, maintaining the current combined rate of 2.4 percent of wages for the next four years.

estonia.title: Viru Prison inmates learn to do traditional Estonian handicraft
estonia.description: Inmates at Viru Prison taught themselves to weave traditional Estonian patterned belts. They have become so skilled that their work is now sold at the Estonian National Museum.

estonia.title: WRC uus boss sai kriitikat: see oli otsus, mille pidime tegema
estonia.description: Tagatubades oli juba ammu selge, et autoralli MM-sarja etappi Saudi Araabias sel aastal ei toimu, kuid kuni viimase hetkeni loodeti, et leitakse asendus. Seda aga ei tulnud ning WRC uus pealik Éric Boullier selgitas, et varuvõistluse korraldamiseks jäi liiga vähe aega.

estonia.title: FOTOD ⟩ Tallinna «närvikõdipink» ajab rahva tagajalgadele: istuja selg on autode poole ja tee vaid käeulatuses
estonia.description: Tallinna kesklinnas Raua tänaval seisab pink, mille asukoht paneb kukalt kratsima. Tallinna XXI kooli vastas asuval pingil tuleb istuda seljaga mööduvate autode poole ning vaadata rahustava linnavaate asemel ilusalongi akendesse. «Järgmine samm on kiiktool,» ironiseeritakse ühismeedias.

estonia.title: Tänak alustas USAs laupäeva kindla katsevõiduga
estonia.description: Ott Tänak ja Martin Järveoja (Toyota Corolla RC2-auto) osalevad 18.-19. septembril USA autoralli meistrivõistluste Tennessee etapil. Eestlased lõpetasid reedese võistluspäeva kindla liidrina ning alustasid laupäeva katsevõiduga. Postimees uuendab uudist iga kiiruskatse järel.

estonia.title: SÜDAMLIKUD KLÕPSUD ⟩ Kerttu Jukkum meenutab poja sünnipäeval pööraseid aastaid: ta ütles, et on liiga noor taoliseks püsisuhteks
estonia.description: Kunagised pisarad koolidirektorite ees, sekeldused ja ema mure on tänaseks selja taha jäänud. Kerttu Jukkum meenutab poja 21. sünnipäeval värvikalt, mida kõike on tulnud aastate jooksul läbi elada.

estonia.title: Aastane kass võitleb elu eest: kliinikus selgus tema raske seisundi ootamatu põhjus
estonia.description: Kõigest aastane kass sattus Pärnumaal raskes seisus veterinaarkliinikusse. Loom ei söönud ega joonud, hingas väga raskelt ning tema munandid olid tugevalt paistes. Kliinikus selgus, et kassi oli mitu korda hammustanud rästik.

estonia.title: RIHO TERRAS ⟩ Ministri sõprussuhted ei saa kaaluda üles usaldust oma riigi vastu
estonia.description: Riigikaitseks raha küsides eeldab valitsus inimestelt usaldust. Maksumaksja iga euro üle tehtud otsus teenib Eesti kaitsevõimet ning riskid peavad seetõttu olema läbikaalutud. Seda usaldust kannavad valitsuse reaalsed teod, mitte ainult sõnad või lubadused, kirjutab Euroopa Parlamendi liige Riho Terras (Isamaa / Euroopa Rahvapartei).

estonia.title: Tartu rattamaratoni esikohad läksid Belgiasse ja Austraaliasse
estonia.description: Laupäeval sõidetud Tartu rattamaratoni distantsid pakkusid põnevust ja nappe võitjate selgumisi alles finišijoonel nii 123 kilomeetri distantsil kui ka lühematel sõitudel.

estonia.title: Hiire ajju viidi enneolematus koguses inimese ajurakke – loe, mis edasi sai
estonia.description: Teadlased on juba aastaid proovinud kasvatada inimese ajurakke loomades, et mõista haigusi, mida hiired ise kunagi ei põe. Nüüd on neuroteadlased leidnud viisi, kuidas inimese ajuorganoidid saavad hiire ajus senisest palju suuremaks kasvada ja kohalike närviahelatega ühenduda. Tulemuseks pole siiski «inimese mõistusega hiir», vaid täiesti uut tüüpi uurimismudel. Just selle piiri tõmbamine osutub aga teaduslikust saavutusest peaaegu sama keeruliseks.

estonia.title: Valtteri Bottas Tartu rattamaratonist: põgenen siia F1 pinge eest, et olla ise mootor!
estonia.description: Laupäeval peetud Tartu rattamaratoni 123 km põhidistants tõi stardijoonele nii rahvusvahelisi tipprattureid kui ka vormel 1 sarja sõitja Valtteri Bottase. Aeg 3:57.41 andis soomlasele 399 lõpetaja seas 88. koha.

estonia.title: Taani välisminister Gröönimaa julgeolekuleppest: järgmine nädal võib tulla hea nädal
estonia.description: Taani välisminister ütles laupäeval, et USAga sõlmitav siduv kokkulepe Gröönimaa julgeoleku kohta tugevdab julgeolekut Arktikas ning leping allkirjastatakse eeldatavasti lähipäevil.

latvia.title: Linksruck bei Wahl ?: In Schweden geht die Furcht vor Schwächung von Nato - Missionen um
NATO ‘ready’ for potential Russian false flag attack, alliance’s top general says
latvia.description: NATO's Adm. Giuseppe Cavo Dragone's remarks follow multiple warnings by European leaders in recent days about a growing risk of Russian escalation.

latvia.title: Inside the secret race to become NATO’s next top general
latvia.description: Germany's Carsten Breuer and Canada's Jennie Carignan are battling it out to become to next chair of NATO's military committee.

latvia.title: Két becsomagolt kézigránátot találtak egy magyar férfi autójának alvázára erősítve a horvát-bosnyák határon
latvia.description: A rendőrség gyanúja szerint a Bosznia-Hercegovinából érkező férfi maga erősítette ragasztószalaggal a gránátokat az autóra, így akarta becsempészni azokat az EU-ba.

latvia.title: Két kézigránátot találtak egy magyar férfi autójának alvázára erősítve a horvát határon
latvia.description: Ragasztószalaggal erősítette őket oda.

latvia.title: Bocsánatot kért és lemondott a győzelemről a sportoló, aki verseny közben csinálta össze magát
latvia.description: Azt írta, most már tudja, hogy az életben több is van a versenyzésnél.

latvia.title: Megroppanhat a NATO, Amerika lépése végleg alááshatja a békét Ukrajnában – Háborús híreink pénteken
latvia.description: Friedrich Merz német kancellár szerint – legalábbis a belátható jövőben – véget ért a második világháború óta fennálló, feltétel nélküli transzatlanti barátság korszaka. A kijelentés újabb jele a Donald Trump elnöksége alatt megrendült amerikai–európai kapcsolatoknak – jelentette a Bloomberg . Az orosz kormány szerint az újabb amerikai büntetőintézkedések megnehezítik az ukrajnai béketárgyalásokat, miután az amerikai képviselőház átfogó szankciós csomagot fogadott el Moszkva ellen – számolt be a Reuters . Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

latvia.title: Veszélybe kerülhet a szövetségesek védelme? Drasztikus lépésre készül az Egyesült Államok
latvia.description: A NATO legmagasabb rangú katonai parancsnoka, Alexus Grynkewich, az amerikai légierő tábornoka pénteken virtuális eligazításon vett részt, amelyen az amerikai csapatok európai állomásoztatásának felülvizsgálatáról tájékoztatta Elbridge Colbyt, a Pentagon védelempolitikai vezetőjét - írja a Reuters.

latvia.title: Vitézy Dávid új államtitkárt nevezett ki
latvia.description: Vitézy Dávid közlekedési és beruházási miniszter Böde Csabát, a Magyar Vonatflotta Zrt. eddigi vezérigazgatóját kérte fel a tárca közösségi közlekedésért és vasútért felelős államtitkári posztjára. Az új államtitkár kiemelt feladata a nagyszabású vasútfejlesztési programok koordinációja, valamint a járműbeszerzések finanszírozási hátterének biztosítása lesz – derült ki Vitézy Dávid Facebook-bejegyzéséből .

latvia.title: Milliárdos mentőövet dobna a kormány, de pillanatokon belül kiürülhetnek a hazai kórházak
latvia.description: A hazai kórházak mindennapi működését és a biztonságos betegellátást már most is súlyosan veszélyezteti a kritikus ápolóhiány, valamint a személyzet elöregedése. Bár a kormányzat 2027-re új bérrendszert és életpályamodellt ígér az ágazatban dolgozóknak, az intézményvezetők szerint a probléma azonnali beavatkozást igényel, mivel az utánpótlás meg sem közelíti a nyugdíjba vonulók létszámát - számolt be a Népszava a Magyar Kórházszövetség konferenciáján elhangzottakról.

latvia.title: Döntött a Magyar Péter vezette kormány: fifikásan költhetnek el óriási összegeket Trump nyomására
latvia.description: A magyar kormány 2035-re a GDP legalább 3,5 százalékára emelné a NATO szabályai szerint elszámolható szűkebb értelemben vett védelmi kiadásokat, és az elért szintet ezt követően is fenn kívánja tartani – derül ki a péntek esti Magyar Közlönyben megjelent kormányhatározatból.

latvia.title: Russia planning “accidental” strikes on eastern NATO states, warns Poland
latvia.description: Russia wants to create a sense of "NATO's helplessness", said Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

latvia.title: Česko zavádí raketový systém Spyder, bude první v NATO
latvia.description: Armáda má novou protivzdušnou obranu - systém Spyder. Podle ministra obrany Jaromíra Zůny (za SPD) prošel vojskovými zkouškami. Izraelský protiletadlový raketový systém nahradí ten stávající, který armáda využívala od 70. let. Jak pro Novinky uvedl plukovník Jaroslav Daverný, Česko bude v rámci NATO první zemí, která systém zavede.

latvia.title: Válka na Ukrajině všechno změnila. Bezpečnost kvůli ní posiluje i Švýcarsko
latvia.description: Mezi evropské země, které kvůli ruské válce na Ukrajině bijí na poplach a snaží se posílit bezpečnost, se zařadilo i Švýcarsko, které není členem NATO. Tamní Spolková rada (ekvivalent federální vlády) v pátek přijala novou bezpečnostní strategii. Ta mimo jiné varuje před nebezpečím hybridních útoků a úderů vedených z velké vzdálenosti. Vyzývá přitom k posílení armádních kapacit, posílení ochrany infrastruktury i snížení kritických závislostí v citlivých oblastech.

latvia.title: Mošnovské letiště v obležení, nejen vojenská technika láká davy lidí
latvia.description: Ne nadarmo se Dnům NATO v Ostravě & Dnům Vzdušných sil Armády ČR přezdívá největší bezpečnostní přehlídka v Evropě. Návštěvnost letošního prvního dne to dokazuje, areál Letiště Leoše Janáčka Ostrava v Mošnově na Novojičínsku v sobotu zaplnily desetitisíce lidí.

latvia.title: Armáda na Dnech NATO ukazuje protivzdušnou obranu či nový přepravní letoun
latvia.description: Na letišti v Mošnově na Novojičínsku v sobotu začaly dvoudenní Dny NATO v Ostravě a Dny Vzdušných sil Armády ČR, které jsou největší bezpečnostní přehlídkou v Evropě. Během zahájení promluvil prezident Petr Pavel, který prohlásil, že „jenom taková země, která bude vnímat svoji bezpečnost jako úkol všech, může být bezpečná a žít v míru“. Ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD) po boku premiéra Andreje Babiše (ANO) upozornil, že bezpečnost není samozřejmost.

latvia.title: Trump podepsal rozsáhlé protiruské sankce iniciované senátorem Grahamem
latvia.description: Americký prezident Donad Trump v pátek podepsal zákon zavádějící rozsáhlé sankce, které mají dostat Rusko pod větší tlak a napomoci ukončení ruské války na Ukrajině. Sankční balík je odkazem republikánského senátora Lindseye Grahama, který zemřel v červenci krátce po své poslední návštěvě Ukrajiny, informovaly světové tiskové agentury.

latvia.title: Zklamání, říká velvyslanec USA o výdajích Česka na obranu. Babiš je hájí
latvia.description: Velvyslanec USA při Severoatlantické alianci (NATO) Matthew Whitaker kritizoval Česko za pomalu rostoucí výdaje na obranu. Na pátečním summitu Mezinárodního institutu strategických studií (IISS) v Praze prohlásil, že postoj Česka je pro Spojené státy americké zklamáním. Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) argumentuje plánovaným splněním minimální dvouprocentní hranice výdajů na obranu příští rok a transparentním jednáním se spojenci.

latvia.title: „S kým a proč budeme bojovat?“ Fico zpochybnil závazek článku 5 NATO
latvia.description: Slovenský premiér Robert Fico (Smer) prohlásil, že v případě ruského útoku nehodlá plnit závazky Slovenska vyplývající z článku 5 Severoatlantické smlouvy o kolektivní obraně. Během projevu ke studentům a zaměstnancům nemocnice v Prešově se ptal, s kým by se vlastně bojovalo, proč a za co, přičemž Moskvu ani jednou neoznačil za agresora.

latvia.title: Vot decisiv și secret în NATO. Cine sunt cei doi candidați care luptă pentru președinția celui mai înalt for militar al Alianței
latvia.description: Cei mai înalți comandanți ai NATO vor alege sâmbătă un nou lider, în cadrul unui vot decisiv care va contribui la definirea modului în care Alianța se pregătește pentru o eventuală incursiune rusă și gestionează tensiunile transatlantice persistente, notează Politico.

latvia.title: Consolidare aliată în regiunea arctică. NATO salută acordul dintre SUA și Danemarca privind Groenlanda
latvia.description: NATO a salutat, sâmbătă, acordul anunţat de Statele Unite cu privire la Groenlanda şi a subliniat că noua înţelegere va contribui la creşterea securităţii, a stabilităţii şi a cooperării în Arctica, o regiune vitală, transmite Reuters.

latvia.title: Europa nu ține pasul cu evoluțiile din domeniul dronelor și al războiului aerian din Ucraina, spune președintele Letoniei
latvia.description: Președintele Letoniei a avertizat că Europa nu ține pasul cu evoluțiile din domeniul dronelor și al războiului aerian din Ucraina și că majoritatea țărilor membre ale NATO nu ar putea respinge un atac cu rachete rusești în cazul în care conflictul s-ar extinde, relatează The Guardian.

latvia.title: Din plantație în pahar. Cum a ajuns cătina „aurul portocaliu” al românilor în sezonul rece. Medic: „E o plantă minune”
latvia.description: Odată cu răcirea vremii, interesul pentru produsele naturiste care cresc imunitatea explodează, iar cătina ocupă primul loc în preferințele consumatorilor. Apreciată pentru proprietățile sale terapeutice extraordinare și conținutul ridicat de vitamine, acest „super-fruct” portocaliu își găsește rapid locul în casele românilor. Oamenii o pregătesc sub diverse forme: de la sucuri concentrate și siropuri pline de energie până la ceaiuri aromate, sperând la un scut natural împotriva bolilor de sezon. Cătina poate fi inclusă într-un stil de viață sănătos, însă nu înlocuiește tratamentele recomandate de medic, atrag atenția specialiștii.

latvia.title: Ședință privind revizuirea desfășurării trupelor SUA în Europa. Purtător de cuvânt al NATO: „Alianţa continuă să se consolideze”
latvia.description: Comandantul suprem al forţelor aliate din Europa (SACEUR), generalul Alexus Grynkewich, din cadrul Forţelor aeriene ale SUA, a participat vineri la o reuniune virtuală de informare cu Elbridge Colby, şeful departamentului pentru politici al Pentagonului, privind posibile abordări ale unei revizuiri a desfăşurării trupelor americane în Europa, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: România va dona Ucrainei interceptoare Patriot. Ce a spus șeful statului despre producția de drone: „Lucrurile sunt avansate”
latvia.description: După ce a participat la summitul inaugural al Inițiativei pentru Integrare Carpatică, președintele Nicușor Dan, aflat în Ucraina, a precizat că România se va număra printre țările NATO care vor dona Kievului interceptoare Patriot. Referitor la drona ajunsă în zona Portului Constanța, șeful statului a explicat că a fost întocmit un raport intern al tuturor instituțiilor implicate, iar în baza acestuia au fost puse întrebări către partea ucraineană.

latvia.title: Robert Fico, despre Articolul 5 al NATO: „Vă puteți imagina că s-ar invoca? Nu vreau ca Slovacia să fie implicată într-un conflict”
latvia.description: Prim-ministrul slovac Robert Fico a declarat că va încerca să mențină țara sa în afara oricărui conflict militar care ar putea apărea în temeiul clauzei de apărare colectivă a NATO, punând public sub semnul întrebării necesitatea ca Slovacia să trimită mii de soldați pentru a apăra un aliat, relatează Kyiv Post.

latvia.title: „Turism patriotic” prin zone de operațiuni de luptă, noua inițiativă din Kursk. Obiectivele din regiunea rusă care ar putea fi vizitate
latvia.description: Guvernatorul regiunii Kursk, Alexander Khinshtein, a declarat că autoritățile regionale colaborează cu armata pentru a identifica posibile trasee turistice prin zone legate de operațiunile de luptă, potrivit The Moscow Times, relatează Kyiv Post.

latvia.title: PSD respinge varianta unei rocade guvernamentale. Daniel Zamfir: „E absolut ridicol”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, a declarat vineri, la Digi24, că partidul său respinge varianta unei rocade guvernamentale, pe care o numește „ridicolă”. Potrivit acestuia, PSD nu va accepta nicio propunere venită din partea premierului desemnat Siegfried Mureșan.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu exclude susținerea pentru Mureșan: „Trebuie să fii cel puțin masochist să bați la ușa AUR. Nici pe vizor nu ne uităm”
latvia.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor Alianței pentru Unirea Românilor (AUR), a exclus, într-o intervenție la Digi24, posibilitatea ca partidul pe care îl reprezintă să îl susțină pe Siegfried Mureșan în Parlament, în momentul în care va veni să ceară votul de învestitură. Peiu consideră că Nicușor Dan și PSD au un plan, în așa fel încât, după ce varianta Siegfried Mureșan pică, să fie nominalizat Sorin Grindeanu pentru funcția de prim-ministru.

latvia.title: Alimente care pot ajuta la menținerea glicemiei și a colesterolului în limite sănătoase. Cum trebuie consumate, potrivit specialiștilor
latvia.description: Alegerile alimentare de zi cu zi pot contribui la controlul glicemiei și la menținerea colesterolului în limite sănătoase, atunci când porțiile sunt adaptate nevoilor individuale. Ce produse pot avea astfel de beneficii și cum ar trebui integrate într-un regim echilibrat.

latvia.title: Șeful NATO spune că Rusia are o „viziune clară” asupra a ceea ce ar declanșa clauza Articolului 5: „Nu vom vorbi niciodată”
latvia.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin are o „viziune clară” asupra a ceea ce ar declanșa clauza de apărare reciprocă prevăzută la Articolul 5 al NATO, în ciuda faptului că Alianța își păstrează în mod deliberat secretele privind liniile roșii, a declarat șeful NATO, Mark Rutte, relatează dpa.

latvia.title: SUA își reevaluează prezența militară în Europa: „Unele țări vor pica testul”. NATO se pregătește pentru un nou echilibru de putere
latvia.description: Presiunea exercitată de Donald Trump asupra NATO schimbă modul în care Europa își construiește apărarea. SUA reevaluează prezența militară pe continent, inclusiv posibilitatea reducerii trupelor americane, în timp ce aliații europeni își majorează cheltuielile și caută alternative la echipamentele și tehnologia americană. România se află în centrul acestei ecuații, prin baza militară de la Mihail Kogălniceanu, unde Statele Unite continuă să investească și să mențină capabilități importante. În același timp, aliații NATO încearcă să se adapteze unui posibil nou echilibru de putere în cadrul alianței, se arată într-o analiză a Reuters.

latvia.title: O fetiţă de nici doi ani s-a înecat cu mâncare, în apropierea unui punct ISU. Pompierii au auzit strigătele martorilor şi au intervenit
latvia.description: O fetiţă de nici doi ani s-a înecat cu mâncare, într-un bloc aflat în apropierea punctului de lucru ISU Floreşti, judeţul Cluj. Pompierii au auzit strigătele disperate ale martorilor şi au fugit pentru a salva copilul. În timp ce unii au acordat primul ajutor, alţii au chemat ajutoare specializate, iar copilul a fost tramsportat la spital, fiind în afara oricărui pericol.

latvia.title: Viorel Oarză a murit la spital, după ce a fost găsit împușcat în cap într-o pădure de lângă Iași / Fostul boxer, cunoscut drept lider al grupării „Brigada”, fusese operat pentru extragerea glonțului
latvia.description: Interlopul Viorel Oarză a murit sâmbătă la Spitalul de Neurochirurgie din Iași, unde era internat în stare critică după ce a fost găsit împușcat în cap într-o pădure de lângă Iași, transmite MEDIAFAX . Viorel Oarză fusese găsit marți într-o pădure din zona localității Holboca. El a fost transportat la spital în stare gravă și […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Estonian sumo wrestler joins Japan's professional league
latvia.description: Estonian sumo wrestler Anatoli Zadorožnõi has officially joined Japan's professional sumo league, the Estonian Sumo Association announced.

latvia.title: LISTEN LIVE: Liepāja Symphony Orchestra's 146th season opening concert
latvia.description: Latvian Radio is delighted to bring you live coverage of the Liepāja Symphony Orchestra's season opening concert on Saturday evening, direct from the 'Lielais Dzintars' concert hall in Liepāja.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Pēteris Vasks sacred music concert
latvia.description: The closing concert of the 29th International Sacred Music Festival featured a special concert of music by this year’s jubilee composer Pēteris Vasks, who is 80 years old.

latvia.title: Latvian border guards stop more illegal crossers
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 17, in Krāslava Municipality, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Kulbergs and Braže meet U.S. envoy to Belarus
latvia.description: On Thursday, 17th September 2026, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, met with the US Special Envoy to Belarus, John Coale.

latvia.title: KNAB to investigate ZZS handing out booze
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will investigate an incident in which the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) gave bottles of black balsam to senior citizens, KNAB said on September 18. This week, on the Latvian Radio programme “Krustpunktā”, a listener asked ZZS MP Augusts Brigmanis to comment on the fact that, at a seniors’ gathering in Ogre on 23 August, the ZZS had given small souvenirs to senior citizens, including a “small bottle of black balsam” bearing the ZZS’s list number for the forthcoming Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Harvest, Old Town, Mushrooms
latvia.description: You would think the festival season is coming to a close, but that is far from the truth. Here are just a few of what you can attend this weekend.

latvia.title: Extra NATO jets coming to Latvia during election period
latvia.description: In a significant development on September 17th, it was announced that extra NATO jets will be coming to Latvia "to reinforce Latvian airspace protection during elections."

latvia.title: Set of stamps to commemorate Latvian basketball star Uļjana Semjonova
latvia.description: In honour of one of Latvia’s greatest ever sportswomen, the world basketball legend Uļjana Semjonova, the state-owned company “Latvijas Pasts” will issue a block of stamps dedicated to her.

latvia.title: Hockey star and Trump family friend added to Latvia's entry blacklist
latvia.description: The Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, has decided to include Russian ice hockey superstar Alexander Ovechkin on Latvia's list of personae non gratae, a Foreign Ministry announcement said on September 17th.

latvia.title: Roadworks continue across Latvia
latvia.description: Construction work is continuing on 53 sections of the national road network, according to a release by Latvian State Roads on September 18.

latvia.title: Latvia to buy Czech artillery system instead of original Swedish option
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 15, the Cabinet of Ministers made a decision to purchase "Morana" 155 mm wheeled artillery systems from the Czech manufacturer Excalibur Army for the needs of the National Armed Forces instead of the Swedish "Archer" systems it originally said it would buy.

latvia.title: Group of asylum seekers returned to Latvia from Poland
latvia.description: This week in Poland, several dozen migrants who had applied for asylum in Latvia were stopped in a lorry. The group was heading towards Germany, but they were returned to Latvia via Lithuania, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

latvia.title: Friday afternoon will be rainy in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that a new band of precipitation will reach Latvia from the west on Friday afternoon.

latvia.title: Ryanair to expand in Latvia, if government helps
latvia.description: The Irish low-cost airline Ryanair is set to increase its flight schedule in Rīga by around 6 per cent during the coming winter season, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Fees to be hiked on Russian grain transit, total ban to be considered
latvia.description: The Saeima Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee on Thursday considered amendments to the law in two readings, which provide for increasing fees for grain transit transportation from Russia until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Criminal case launched regarding drunk driving welfare minister in Latvia
latvia.description: The Prosecutor’s Office has received the criminal case against Reinis Uzulnieks, the former Minister for Welfare, who was driving under the influence of alcohol, the LETA news agency reported on September 17.

latvia.title: Streaming platforms will be asked to support Latvian film production
latvia.description: It is planned that in future the major streaming platforms will have to invest money in the development of Latvian cinema every year according to law changes supported by the Saeima on September 17th.

latvia.title: Saeima moves towards full Russian food ban
latvia.description: A ban on importing products originating in Russia and Belarus will in future apply not only to agricultural goods and animal feed, but also to food products, according to amendments to the Agriculture and Rural Development Law, which were supported by the Saeima on Thursday, September 10. However, it should be noted that a final reading of the legislation is still required before coming into force.

latvia.title: Liepāja Concert Hall to be headed by Kate Erharde
latvia.description: Following the conclusion of the open competition for the position of board member at SIA “Lielais dzintars”, Kate Erharde – an industry professional with experience in the Latvian and international cultural scene – will become the new director of the concert hall.

latvia.title: Latvia's Euro volleyball hopes remain alive
latvia.description: A crucial win over Turkiye on September 16th means Latvia has made it into the knock-out stages of the men's European volleyball cjhampionships.

latvia.title: U.S. expert: Baltic states have no need to panic, but need to prepare
latvia.description: David M. Cattler is a Senior Fellow with the Transatlantic Defense and Security Program at the Center for European Policy Analysis (CEPA). He is a transatlantic security expert with more than 35 years of experience across the US government, NATO, and the Intelligence Community. During the recent Riga Conference event, he took time to speak with LSM's Anton Chernetskyi about a range of topical matters. The transcript of the conversation is reproduced below and you can watch a video of the interview above.

latvia.title: Latest list of Latvian companies doing business with Russia and Belarus published
latvia.description: On September 17th, an updated list of companies registered in Latvia that export goods to Russia or Belarus or import goods from these countries has been published on the website of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB).

latvia.title: Latvian Security Service launches case against terrorist threats
latvia.description: The State Security Service (VDD), in response to an ultimatum publicly issued by a pro-Kremlin group, launched criminal proceedings on 9 September this year regarding threats to carry out acts of terrorism against companies in Latvia that supply arms to Ukraine, the VDD reported.

latvia.title: Double diaspora events happening on Friday
latvia.description: On Friday, September 18th, 2026, two diaspora events will be held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: the Latvian Diaspora Forum 2026 and the Diaspora Advisory Council meeting.

latvia.title: Ambassadors visit Latvia's eastern border region
latvia.description: Foreign ambassadors were the latest group to make the trip to Latvia's eastern border on September 16th, following on from recent outings for the President, Finance Minister and visiting diginataries.

latvia.title: Bus strike caused inconveniences to many Latvian residents
latvia.description: On Wednesday, 16 September, bus services across Latvia’s regions were considerably lighter than usual. Due to a protest by passenger transport operators, more than 3,000 journeys were cancelled, and the consequences were felt by those who use public transport to commute to work every day, as well as by schoolchildren, Latvian Television and Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Latvian PM says Baltics should 'speak as one' on Rail Baltica issue
latvia.description: The Baltic states must speak as one on the “Rail Baltica” issue, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) stated following a meeting with President Edgars Rinkēvičs on September 16.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 16th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: U.S. court ruling will allow airBaltic to receive 140 million euros
latvia.description: Latvian national airline airBaltic will immediately receive a first tranche of financing worth 140 million euros out of total planned financing of 350 million euros, in accordance with the decision of the Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York in the United States of America (US). airBaltic has attracted this financing from international investors.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia v Türkiye European Championship volleyball
latvia.description: Latvia plays Türkiye in an international volleyball match on September 16th. Watch live, courtesy of Latvian Television's coverage.

latvia.title: Ventspils can lay claim to being Latvia's bicycle capital
latvia.description: The country may be relatively flat and picturesque, but Latvia's bicycle infrastructure is often a bit of a disappointment to visitors from bike-friendly countries such as the Netherlands.

latvia.title: Union calls for Latvian Health Minister to quit
latvia.description: A month after Health Minister Hossam Abu Meri (New Unity) survived a no confidence vote in the Latvian parliament, a medics' union has called on him to quit.

latvia.title: President pardons inventor who warned CSDD about IT vulnerability
latvia.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs has pardoned inventor Raimonds Skuruls, who was recently convicted of extortion in connection with a security vulnerability discovered in the Road Traffic Safety Directorate's (CSDD) information technology (IT) system, presidential advisor Mārtiņš Drēģeris confirmed to the LETA newswire on Wednesday.

latvia.title: Saeima might be subjected to state audits in future
latvia.description: On Wednesday, the Saeima’s Public Administration and Local Government Committee backed the proposal to subject parliament to audits by the State Audit Office.

latvia.title: Pre-election debates see Latvian politicians making bold (but false) claims
latvia.description: As the 15th Saeima elections approach, debates between representatives of political forces are taking place virtually non-stop across various Latvian media outlets. "Re:Baltica"'s fact-checking project "Re:Check" investigated misleading statements made by politicians in them.

latvia.title: Namejs military drills taking place in and around Rīga
latvia.description: From 16 to 20 September, the active phase of the comprehensive national defence exercise ‘Namejs 2026’ will take place in Rīga and the surrounding area, according to the Rīga City Council.

latvia.title: Special awards for Italian pilots who shot down drone over Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 15, Latvian Minister of Defence Raivis Melnis welcomed Italian Minister of Defence Guido Crosetto on a working visit and the pair used the occasion to hand out medals to Italian fighter pilots who recently downed a drone over Latvian territory.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs packs his bags for lengthy trip to America
latvia.description: President Edgars Rinkēvičs will pay a working visit to the United States from September 17th to 28th to participate in the opening of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York and the 75th anniversary congress of the Latvian Association of America in Washington.

latvia.title: Latvian volleyball team loses again but has one last chance
latvia.description: The Latvian men's volleyball team lost 1:3 to the Swiss national team in the penultimate game of the group stages of the European Championship on Tuesday, but thanks to results elsewhere the team maintains a hope of securing a place in the round of 16.

latvia.title: Bear killer may face fine
latvia.description: On October 31 last year, a three-year-old brown bear was illegally shot in Ogre region. During the subsequent investigation, it was determined that the animal was shot by a man born in 1972. He has not been named.

latvia.title: State Audit: Children's healthcare only a formal priority in Latvia
latvia.description: The law designates children’s healthcare as a priority, but in practice, no system has been put in place to ensure that this priority is upheld, the State Audit Office concluded in its audit published on 16 September.

latvia.title: Hundreds of bus routes cancelled Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: On Wednesday, 16 September, a protest organised by the Latvian Passenger Transport Association (LPPA) is taking place across Latvia, with eight transport operators taking part. During the protest, the operators will not run state-commissioned bus services, and it is estimated that up to 3,000 regional bus services and up to 60,000 passengers could be affected.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 15th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Switzerland men's European Chapmionship volleyball
latvia.description: Latvia plays Switzerland in an international volleyball match on September 15th. Watch live, courtesy of Latvian Television's coverage.

latvia.title: Young Latvians like to stay at home longer than Estonians and Lithuanians
latvia.description: New data published on September 15th by Eurostat shows that young Latvians are more reluctant to fly the family nest than their counterparts in Estonia and Lithuania.

latvia.title: American family finds a happy home in Latvia
latvia.description: Anna and Garrett Bergeson come from the United States of America. Together they are raising two children: Raivo and Ženija. Several years ago, the family decided to choose Latvia as their home.

latvia.title: Dance teacher in Dobele, Latvia arrested for sexual harassment of minors
latvia.description: The State Police have arrested a dance teacher in Dobele on suspicion of sexual harassment of minors and are calling on any potential victims to come forward, the police said.

latvia.title: The biggest challenge in the IT market: competing for talent
latvia.description: Latvia’s IT sector has long since ceased to compete solely within national borders – today, a skilled software developer, data specialist or cybersecurity expert can work for a company in Riga, Berlin or New York without ever having to relocate. This fundamentally changes the rules of the game for both Latvian businesses and the public sector.

latvia.title: Big public transport strike expected Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: Due to the protest action ‘A Day Without Regional Public Transport’, organised by the Latvian Passenger Transport Association (LPPA), on Wednesday, 16 September, 1,271 regional bus services will not run, according to information compiled by the Road Transport Directorate (ATD), as reported by Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: “Beidzot varam teikt, ka Lauris ir atrasts!” Noslēgusies Laura Mihailova meklēšana
latvia.description: Jau pirms aptuveni pusotras nedēļas parādījās pirmās ziņas, ka Valsts policija un tuvinieki meklē prombūtnē esošo Lauri Mihailovu. Viņa pēdējā atrašanās vieta bija Budapešta, Ungārija. Pirms divām dienām Laura tuvinieki paziņoja, ka vīrietis esot atrasts. Bija zināma precīzāka viņa atrašanās vieta, taču, viņu joprojām meklēja Valsts policija, jo likumsargiem ar Lauri sazināties neizdevās. Taču nu […]

latvia.title: Horoskopi 20. septembris. Šodien var kļūt zināms kas tāds, kas līdz šim bijis noklusēts vai palicis aizkulisēs
latvia.description: Auns Šodien ir vērts nepazemināt pašam savas iespējas un nenovērtēt par zemu to, ko vari paveikt. Iespējams, tev ir vairāk spēka, zināšanu un resursu, nekā sākumā šķiet. Tāpēc nesteidzies atteikties no iecerēm tikai šaubu vai nedrošības dēļ. Ja apzināsies savas stiprās puses un izmantosi tās īstajā brīdī, diena var izrādīties daudz veiksmīgāka. Vērsis Šī diena […]

latvia.title: Kāds prieks! Latvijas 3×3 basketbolistiem sudraba medaļas U-23 Pasaules kausā
latvia.description: Latvijas vīriešu 3×3 basketbola izlase, kuras sastāvā ir Mārtiņš Bumbieris, Kristofers Karlsons, Dāvis Skreivers un Mārtiņš Evarts Zviedris, sestdien Uhaņā izcīnīja sudraba medaļas U-23 Pasaules kausā. Ar otro numuru izsētā Latvijas izlase finālā ar 18:19 zaudēja ar piekto numuru izliktajai Lietuvai. Latvijas izlasē astoņus punktus guva Karlsons, pieci punkti bija Skreiveram, četri – Zviedrim, bet […]

latvia.title: CSDD datu noplūdes lietā pavīd reāla cerība iegūt kompensāciju: advokāts atklāj jaunas detaļas
latvia.description: Pēc CSDD datu noplūdes incidenta publiskajā telpā izskanējusi daudz un dažāda informācija par iedzīvotāju iespējām pieprasīt kompensāciju par notikušo. Kamēr jautājums par atbildību un iespējamo atlīdzību joprojām tiek vērtēts, ar pozitīvām ziņām nācis klajā zvērināts advokāts Lauris Klagišs, kurš norāda uz Satiksmes ministrijas publicētā CSDD kiberincidenta izvērtējuma secinājumiem. Viņaprāt, tajā konstatētie drošības trūkumi varētu būt […]

latvia.title: TESTS. Pie kura galdiņa tu sēstos kafejnīcā? Izvēlē slēpjas pavedieni par tevi pašu
latvia.description: Ieejot omulīgā, pustumsas ieskautā un sarunu kņadas pildītā kafejnīcā, mēs reti kad galdiņu izvēlamies nejauši. Mūsu zemapziņa meklē vietu, kas attiecīgajā brīdī sniedz tieši to, kas mums nepieciešams: drošību, iedvesmu, mājīgumu vai piedzīvojumu. Apskati attēlu, ieklausies savā pirmajā impulsā un izvēlies galdiņu no 1 līdz 6, pie kura tu apsēstos jau tagad. Ko šī izvēle […]

lithuania.title: NATO ‘ready’ for potential Russian false flag attack, alliance’s top general says
lithuania.description: NATO's Adm. Giuseppe Cavo Dragone's remarks follow multiple warnings by European leaders in recent days about a growing risk of Russian escalation.

lithuania.title: Inside the secret race to become NATO’s next top general
lithuania.description: Germany's Carsten Breuer and Canada's Jennie Carignan are battling it out to become to next chair of NATO's military committee.

lithuania.title: Két becsomagolt kézigránátot találtak egy magyar férfi autójának alvázára erősítve a horvát-bosnyák határon
lithuania.description: A rendőrség gyanúja szerint a Bosznia-Hercegovinából érkező férfi maga erősítette ragasztószalaggal a gránátokat az autóra, így akarta becsempészni azokat az EU-ba.

lithuania.title: Két kézigránátot találtak egy magyar férfi autójának alvázára erősítve a horvát határon
lithuania.description: Ragasztószalaggal erősítette őket oda.

lithuania.title: Bocsánatot kért és lemondott a győzelemről a sportoló, aki verseny közben csinálta össze magát
lithuania.description: Azt írta, most már tudja, hogy az életben több is van a versenyzésnél.

lithuania.title: Megroppanhat a NATO, Amerika lépése végleg alááshatja a békét Ukrajnában – Háborús híreink pénteken
lithuania.description: Friedrich Merz német kancellár szerint – legalábbis a belátható jövőben – véget ért a második világháború óta fennálló, feltétel nélküli transzatlanti barátság korszaka. A kijelentés újabb jele a Donald Trump elnöksége alatt megrendült amerikai–európai kapcsolatoknak – jelentette a Bloomberg . Az orosz kormány szerint az újabb amerikai büntetőintézkedések megnehezítik az ukrajnai béketárgyalásokat, miután az amerikai képviselőház átfogó szankciós csomagot fogadott el Moszkva ellen – számolt be a Reuters . Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Veszélybe kerülhet a szövetségesek védelme? Drasztikus lépésre készül az Egyesült Államok
lithuania.description: A NATO legmagasabb rangú katonai parancsnoka, Alexus Grynkewich, az amerikai légierő tábornoka pénteken virtuális eligazításon vett részt, amelyen az amerikai csapatok európai állomásoztatásának felülvizsgálatáról tájékoztatta Elbridge Colbyt, a Pentagon védelempolitikai vezetőjét - írja a Reuters.

lithuania.title: Milliárdos mentőövet dobna a kormány, de pillanatokon belül kiürülhetnek a hazai kórházak
lithuania.description: A hazai kórházak mindennapi működését és a biztonságos betegellátást már most is súlyosan veszélyezteti a kritikus ápolóhiány, valamint a személyzet elöregedése. Bár a kormányzat 2027-re új bérrendszert és életpályamodellt ígér az ágazatban dolgozóknak, az intézményvezetők szerint a probléma azonnali beavatkozást igényel, mivel az utánpótlás meg sem közelíti a nyugdíjba vonulók létszámát - számolt be a Népszava a Magyar Kórházszövetség konferenciáján elhangzottakról.

lithuania.title: Döntött a Magyar Péter vezette kormány: fifikásan költhetnek el óriási összegeket Trump nyomására
lithuania.description: A magyar kormány 2035-re a GDP legalább 3,5 százalékára emelné a NATO szabályai szerint elszámolható szűkebb értelemben vett védelmi kiadásokat, és az elért szintet ezt követően is fenn kívánja tartani – derül ki a péntek esti Magyar Közlönyben megjelent kormányhatározatból.

lithuania.title: Russia planning “accidental” strikes on eastern NATO states, warns Poland
lithuania.description: Russia wants to create a sense of "NATO's helplessness", said Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

lithuania.title: Česko zavádí raketový systém Spyder, bude první v NATO
lithuania.description: Armáda má novou protivzdušnou obranu - systém Spyder. Podle ministra obrany Jaromíra Zůny (za SPD) prošel vojskovými zkouškami. Izraelský protiletadlový raketový systém nahradí ten stávající, který armáda využívala od 70. let. Jak pro Novinky uvedl plukovník Jaroslav Daverný, Česko bude v rámci NATO první zemí, která systém zavede.

lithuania.title: Válka na Ukrajině všechno změnila. Bezpečnost kvůli ní posiluje i Švýcarsko
lithuania.description: Mezi evropské země, které kvůli ruské válce na Ukrajině bijí na poplach a snaží se posílit bezpečnost, se zařadilo i Švýcarsko, které není členem NATO. Tamní Spolková rada (ekvivalent federální vlády) v pátek přijala novou bezpečnostní strategii. Ta mimo jiné varuje před nebezpečím hybridních útoků a úderů vedených z velké vzdálenosti. Vyzývá přitom k posílení armádních kapacit, posílení ochrany infrastruktury i snížení kritických závislostí v citlivých oblastech.

lithuania.title: Mošnovské letiště v obležení, nejen vojenská technika láká davy lidí
lithuania.description: Ne nadarmo se Dnům NATO v Ostravě & Dnům Vzdušných sil Armády ČR přezdívá největší bezpečnostní přehlídka v Evropě. Návštěvnost letošního prvního dne to dokazuje, areál Letiště Leoše Janáčka Ostrava v Mošnově na Novojičínsku v sobotu zaplnily desetitisíce lidí.

lithuania.title: Armáda na Dnech NATO ukazuje protivzdušnou obranu či nový přepravní letoun
lithuania.description: Na letišti v Mošnově na Novojičínsku v sobotu začaly dvoudenní Dny NATO v Ostravě a Dny Vzdušných sil Armády ČR, které jsou největší bezpečnostní přehlídkou v Evropě. Během zahájení promluvil prezident Petr Pavel, který prohlásil, že „jenom taková země, která bude vnímat svoji bezpečnost jako úkol všech, může být bezpečná a žít v míru“. Ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD) po boku premiéra Andreje Babiše (ANO) upozornil, že bezpečnost není samozřejmost.

lithuania.title: Trump podepsal rozsáhlé protiruské sankce iniciované senátorem Grahamem
lithuania.description: Americký prezident Donad Trump v pátek podepsal zákon zavádějící rozsáhlé sankce, které mají dostat Rusko pod větší tlak a napomoci ukončení ruské války na Ukrajině. Sankční balík je odkazem republikánského senátora Lindseye Grahama, který zemřel v červenci krátce po své poslední návštěvě Ukrajiny, informovaly světové tiskové agentury.

lithuania.title: Zklamání, říká velvyslanec USA o výdajích Česka na obranu. Babiš je hájí
lithuania.description: Velvyslanec USA při Severoatlantické alianci (NATO) Matthew Whitaker kritizoval Česko za pomalu rostoucí výdaje na obranu. Na pátečním summitu Mezinárodního institutu strategických studií (IISS) v Praze prohlásil, že postoj Česka je pro Spojené státy americké zklamáním. Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) argumentuje plánovaným splněním minimální dvouprocentní hranice výdajů na obranu příští rok a transparentním jednáním se spojenci.

lithuania.title: „S kým a proč budeme bojovat?“ Fico zpochybnil závazek článku 5 NATO
lithuania.description: Slovenský premiér Robert Fico (Smer) prohlásil, že v případě ruského útoku nehodlá plnit závazky Slovenska vyplývající z článku 5 Severoatlantické smlouvy o kolektivní obraně. Během projevu ke studentům a zaměstnancům nemocnice v Prešově se ptal, s kým by se vlastně bojovalo, proč a za co, přičemž Moskvu ani jednou neoznačil za agresora.

lithuania.title: Vot decisiv și secret în NATO. Cine sunt cei doi candidați care luptă pentru președinția celui mai înalt for militar al Alianței
lithuania.description: Cei mai înalți comandanți ai NATO vor alege sâmbătă un nou lider, în cadrul unui vot decisiv care va contribui la definirea modului în care Alianța se pregătește pentru o eventuală incursiune rusă și gestionează tensiunile transatlantice persistente, notează Politico.

lithuania.title: Consolidare aliată în regiunea arctică. NATO salută acordul dintre SUA și Danemarca privind Groenlanda
lithuania.description: NATO a salutat, sâmbătă, acordul anunţat de Statele Unite cu privire la Groenlanda şi a subliniat că noua înţelegere va contribui la creşterea securităţii, a stabilităţii şi a cooperării în Arctica, o regiune vitală, transmite Reuters.

lithuania.title: Europa nu ține pasul cu evoluțiile din domeniul dronelor și al războiului aerian din Ucraina, spune președintele Letoniei
lithuania.description: Președintele Letoniei a avertizat că Europa nu ține pasul cu evoluțiile din domeniul dronelor și al războiului aerian din Ucraina și că majoritatea țărilor membre ale NATO nu ar putea respinge un atac cu rachete rusești în cazul în care conflictul s-ar extinde, relatează The Guardian.

lithuania.title: Din plantație în pahar. Cum a ajuns cătina „aurul portocaliu” al românilor în sezonul rece. Medic: „E o plantă minune”
lithuania.description: Odată cu răcirea vremii, interesul pentru produsele naturiste care cresc imunitatea explodează, iar cătina ocupă primul loc în preferințele consumatorilor. Apreciată pentru proprietățile sale terapeutice extraordinare și conținutul ridicat de vitamine, acest „super-fruct” portocaliu își găsește rapid locul în casele românilor. Oamenii o pregătesc sub diverse forme: de la sucuri concentrate și siropuri pline de energie până la ceaiuri aromate, sperând la un scut natural împotriva bolilor de sezon. Cătina poate fi inclusă într-un stil de viață sănătos, însă nu înlocuiește tratamentele recomandate de medic, atrag atenția specialiștii.

lithuania.title: Ședință privind revizuirea desfășurării trupelor SUA în Europa. Purtător de cuvânt al NATO: „Alianţa continuă să se consolideze”
lithuania.description: Comandantul suprem al forţelor aliate din Europa (SACEUR), generalul Alexus Grynkewich, din cadrul Forţelor aeriene ale SUA, a participat vineri la o reuniune virtuală de informare cu Elbridge Colby, şeful departamentului pentru politici al Pentagonului, privind posibile abordări ale unei revizuiri a desfăşurării trupelor americane în Europa, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: România va dona Ucrainei interceptoare Patriot. Ce a spus șeful statului despre producția de drone: „Lucrurile sunt avansate”
lithuania.description: După ce a participat la summitul inaugural al Inițiativei pentru Integrare Carpatică, președintele Nicușor Dan, aflat în Ucraina, a precizat că România se va număra printre țările NATO care vor dona Kievului interceptoare Patriot. Referitor la drona ajunsă în zona Portului Constanța, șeful statului a explicat că a fost întocmit un raport intern al tuturor instituțiilor implicate, iar în baza acestuia au fost puse întrebări către partea ucraineană.

lithuania.title: Robert Fico, despre Articolul 5 al NATO: „Vă puteți imagina că s-ar invoca? Nu vreau ca Slovacia să fie implicată într-un conflict”
lithuania.description: Prim-ministrul slovac Robert Fico a declarat că va încerca să mențină țara sa în afara oricărui conflict militar care ar putea apărea în temeiul clauzei de apărare colectivă a NATO, punând public sub semnul întrebării necesitatea ca Slovacia să trimită mii de soldați pentru a apăra un aliat, relatează Kyiv Post.

lithuania.title: „Turism patriotic” prin zone de operațiuni de luptă, noua inițiativă din Kursk. Obiectivele din regiunea rusă care ar putea fi vizitate
lithuania.description: Guvernatorul regiunii Kursk, Alexander Khinshtein, a declarat că autoritățile regionale colaborează cu armata pentru a identifica posibile trasee turistice prin zone legate de operațiunile de luptă, potrivit The Moscow Times, relatează Kyiv Post.

lithuania.title: Una dintre țările baltice a făcut planuri detaliate pentru evacuarea populației în Polonia, în cazul în care e atacată de Putin
lithuania.description: Autoritățile din Lituania au elaborat un plan detaliat de evacuare a populației în cazul unei amenințări militare sau al unei crize grave, care prevede, printre altele, transportul locuitorilor din Vilnius în Polonia. Informația a fost difuzată de Polskie Radio. Conform publicației, autoritățile din voievodatul Podlasie din Polonia pregătesc în prezent regiunea pentru un eventual rol de coridor de tranzit pentru locuitorii țărilor baltice.

lithuania.title: PSD respinge varianta unei rocade guvernamentale. Daniel Zamfir: „E absolut ridicol”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, a declarat vineri, la Digi24, că partidul său respinge varianta unei rocade guvernamentale, pe care o numește „ridicolă”. Potrivit acestuia, PSD nu va accepta nicio propunere venită din partea premierului desemnat Siegfried Mureșan.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu exclude susținerea pentru Mureșan: „Trebuie să fii cel puțin masochist să bați la ușa AUR. Nici pe vizor nu ne uităm”
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor Alianței pentru Unirea Românilor (AUR), a exclus, într-o intervenție la Digi24, posibilitatea ca partidul pe care îl reprezintă să îl susțină pe Siegfried Mureșan în Parlament, în momentul în care va veni să ceară votul de învestitură. Peiu consideră că Nicușor Dan și PSD au un plan, în așa fel încât, după ce varianta Siegfried Mureșan pică, să fie nominalizat Sorin Grindeanu pentru funcția de prim-ministru.

lithuania.title: Alimente care pot ajuta la menținerea glicemiei și a colesterolului în limite sănătoase. Cum trebuie consumate, potrivit specialiștilor
lithuania.description: Alegerile alimentare de zi cu zi pot contribui la controlul glicemiei și la menținerea colesterolului în limite sănătoase, atunci când porțiile sunt adaptate nevoilor individuale. Ce produse pot avea astfel de beneficii și cum ar trebui integrate într-un regim echilibrat.

lithuania.title: Șeful NATO spune că Rusia are o „viziune clară” asupra a ceea ce ar declanșa clauza Articolului 5: „Nu vom vorbi niciodată”
lithuania.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin are o „viziune clară” asupra a ceea ce ar declanșa clauza de apărare reciprocă prevăzută la Articolul 5 al NATO, în ciuda faptului că Alianța își păstrează în mod deliberat secretele privind liniile roșii, a declarat șeful NATO, Mark Rutte, relatează dpa.

lithuania.title: SUA își reevaluează prezența militară în Europa: „Unele țări vor pica testul”. NATO se pregătește pentru un nou echilibru de putere
lithuania.description: Presiunea exercitată de Donald Trump asupra NATO schimbă modul în care Europa își construiește apărarea. SUA reevaluează prezența militară pe continent, inclusiv posibilitatea reducerii trupelor americane, în timp ce aliații europeni își majorează cheltuielile și caută alternative la echipamentele și tehnologia americană. România se află în centrul acestei ecuații, prin baza militară de la Mihail Kogălniceanu, unde Statele Unite continuă să investească și să mențină capabilități importante. În același timp, aliații NATO încearcă să se adapteze unui posibil nou echilibru de putere în cadrul alianței, se arată într-o analiză a Reuters.

lithuania.title: Estonia and the U.S. seek rare‑earth agreement
lithuania.description: Estonia and the United States are working toward an agreement on rare earth elements to strengthen supply security. The talks are not about Estonia's mineral deposits; the goal is to develop local industry and attract new investment, says Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna. On Thursday, Lithuania signed a similar agreement with the U.S.

lithuania.title: Estonian sumo wrestler joins Japan's professional league
lithuania.description: Estonian sumo wrestler Anatoli Zadorožnõi has officially joined Japan's professional sumo league, the Estonian Sumo Association announced.

lithuania.title: Extra NATO jets coming to Latvia during election period
lithuania.description: In a significant development on September 17th, it was announced that extra NATO jets will be coming to Latvia "to reinforce Latvian airspace protection during elections."

lithuania.title: Group of asylum seekers returned to Latvia from Poland
lithuania.description: This week in Poland, several dozen migrants who had applied for asylum in Latvia were stopped in a lorry. The group was heading towards Germany, but they were returned to Latvia via Lithuania, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

lithuania.title: Young Latvians like to stay at home longer than Estonians and Lithuanians
lithuania.description: New data published on September 15th by Eurostat shows that young Latvians are more reluctant to fly the family nest than their counterparts in Estonia and Lithuania.
